intent: Prospectively determine whether fresh public action-observation streams contain learnable historical predictive information beyond full-current-public controls, before Q22 active information acquisition or a new cognitive learner. This gate does not validate cognitive transfer.

hypothesis.H1: In each of two new qualitatively distinct source-free regimes, a FIT-trained history-conditioned predictor reduces future public-observation negative log loss relative to the strongest fully trained full-current-public predictor with the same known action window.
hypothesis.H0: If genuine public history is not predictive beyond current observations and action windows, no history model should produce a material positive held-development gain.
hypothesis.separation: Decompose low ceiling (information insufficiency) from failure of a particular optimizer/model to approach the achievable public-history predictive ceiling; report both without assuming one implies the other.

source_free_families.description: An unknown binary state follows an action-conditioned symmetric flip process. One of two anonymous noisy public sensors emits it; the other emits independent fair noise. Sensor role is randomized independently per episode and never exposed.

An unknown binary state normally persists; a consecutive pair of public action-1 events toggles it, with independent symmetric transition noise. Anonymous sensor-role randomization and distractor as in A. This structure differs causally from family A.
Both public binary sensors are independently sampled fair bits each step, actions have no causal influence, and no persistent public history signal exists.

public_observation_contract: At time t each arm observes o_0..o_t and a_0..a_t before predicting o_(t+1); use no future observations/actions. Current-state controls see o_t, a_t, and a_(t-1) where defined, so delayed-action knowledge does not manufacture a memory gain. Latent state, sensor role, rule identity, generator parameters and future outcomes are never public model inputs.
action_policy: All arms receive the same action/observation trajectories. Each a_t is sampled from Bernoulli(1/2) before the state transition; no model-selected action in Q21. Policy learning is a distinct prospective Q22 gate and must not be retroactively added here.

role_separation.reset_cluster_unit: Entire episode, including role-drawn responsive sensor identity; scored next-bit observations within an episode are not independent samples.
role_separation.source_access: No Q20 observed or reserved source cohorts, no MiniGrid/Pycolab, no original scientific first-use, and no held-out cross-family/long-horizon transfer generation.

memoryless_controls: FIT-trained full-current-and-action-window multinomial outcome counts with Dirichlet smoothing (all observed sensor joint states retained)
FIT-trained full-current-and-action-window logistic prediction for each next public bit
history_controls: FIT-trained public-lagged action/observation counts with smoothing
FIT-trained unsupervised 2-state and 4-state action-aware HMM via EM
comparator_contract.training: All empirical models receive identical FIT_TRAIN public trajectories; select epochs/restarts using FIT_VALID alone with frozen stopping schedule. Never select, tune, train or rewrite model weights on DEV.
theoretical_diagnostics: PUBLIC_MARGINALIZED_BAYES: generator-law-aware filtering, integrating unknown per-episode responsive sensor, latent state and observation noise rather than revealing secret episode draws. Privileged model, diagnostic only; not a matched empirical comparator.
PRIVILEGED_LATENT_CEILING: may additionally know true hidden episode state/sensor role, always separately marked privileged and excluded from any empirical-win claim.

metrics.primary: Development mean next-public-sensor Bernoulli NLL, nats per bit; log probabilities evaluated on exact observed bits.
metrics.per_family: Report complete per-family scores, pairwise history-minus-current gap, oracle diagnostic headroom, and false-positive counts as descriptive diagnostics without using ordinary bit mispredictions as hard causal false positives.
metrics.uncertainty: 2048 deterministic paired bootstrap replicates by independently seeded complete DEV episodes, never by sensor bit; report two-sided 95% percentile confidence interval.
metrics.cross_os: Windows and Linux must agree on cohort SHA-256, model/prereg IDs, outcome and score ordering. Predeclared numerical tolerance 1e-6 nats/bit; checkpoint byte hashes must be recorded, and differing hashes are not called bit-identical.
metrics.resources: Full generator, FIT, checkpoint selection, DEV inference and audit CPU process time; peak RSS, tracemalloc, serialized model bytes, wire/adapter bytes; record each separately and total by model/OS.

frozen_dev_decision.attribution: If public oracle headroom is small, classify information-limit. If oracle headroom is sufficient but empirical history learning fails, classify trainability/model-limit. A negative null control violation is method-integrity NO-GO. These descriptive classes do not override failure.

hard_guards: Preregister immutable source and decision contract before implementing or generating any Q21 episode.
Do not reuse exposed Q20 FIT/DEV or instantiate Q20 reserved unfamiliar-task holdouts.
Use only new source-free synthetic development data; original-source protected scientific first-use remains untouched.
No revisions to thresholds after seeing Q21 outcomes; retain all outcomes, including negative classes.
No new optimizer mechanism, model promotion, protected branch merge, CKB-plane queue/dispatch/controller mutation, unattended scheduler or broker action in this gate.
Implementation requires exact parent/source pin, bounded allowlist, adversarial tests, independent native Windows/Linux qualification, and final full regression before formal admission.
Prior cached focused evidence may be reused only with exact qualification keys; final full regression cannot be cached away.
This preregistration is advisory and is not execution or scientific first-use authorization; CKB-plane alone controls execution/orchestration and acceptance.
